thought_path_snapshot: Identify all positions of heaters in the array. This will help us determine which segments of the array need to be covered by the heaters' ranges.

The previous approach incorrectly counted the number of heaters needed by checking each position individually without considering the optimal placement of heaters. The corrected strategy should greedily select heaters to cover the maximum uncovered segment of the house, ensuring that each position is covered by at least one heater while minimizing the total number of heaters used.
Sort the positions of heaters. Sorting will make it easier to determine the optimal placement of heaters to cover the entire array without overlap.

The previous approach incorrectly assumed that incrementing the index `i` by `2 * r` after finding a suitable heater would cover all necessary segments of the house. This led to skipping over parts of the house that needed to be warmed up. The corrected strategy should ensure that each segment of the house is covered by at least one heater, taking into account the overlap and range of heaters.
